errors.error_description: Introduced multiple continuous drivers on the same wire by assigning 'shared_en' from two sources; the second assignment is marked.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential block by using a blocking assignment to 'shadow' alongside non-blocking updates.
Missing default case in the state transition 'case' statement; the 'case' line is marked to indicate the incomplete FSM handling.
Created an unintended latch by incompletely assigning 'inc_value' in a combinational block without an else path.
